message:
You know that feeling when you casually mention a storm might be coming and everyone rolls their eyes? Well, here’s a little something I found that could serve as a reminder that Mother Nature doesn’t always play nice. This resource has some solid tips on how to stay safe during thunderstorms and lightning, which is always a good thing to keep in mind.

So, next time the skies turn ominous, you can be the one nodding knowingly while others scramble to find cover. What’s your best storm prep tip? 🌩️
